detail.construction: Public: d, n, gamma, R, x0, K (number of applied updates). Query = Option ((Fin n -> Point d) x (Fin n -> R)): the point each worker is computing at and its start time; Reply = Option (Fin n x R x Point d): arriving worker, arrival time, stochastic gradient. State: count k, current point x^k, points, starts, iters (iteration whose point each worker computes at), clock (time of the last update), chosen (index of the output iterate) and selected. step on reply (i, t, G): x^{k+1} = x^k - gamma G; every worker j with j = i or R <= k + 1 - iters j (delay >= R at iteration k+1, the stop rule) restarts at x^{k+1} at time t with iters j = k+1; clock = t; selected becomes x^{k+1} if chosen = k+1. ringmaster: Seed = Fin (K+1) with uniform law (output iterate index), initial: all workers at x^0, time 0, iteration 0; query = none once K updates are done; output = (selected, clock). eventAnswer/eventOracle: the universal-model environment returning the earliest completion (completion of work(v_i) from the start time) with g(points i, fresh seed); arrivalOracle: arbitrary arrival order arrive k with time 0. history/delayedIterate: x^0 = x0, x^{k+1} = x^k - gamma g(x^{a_k}, xi_k) (the iterate sequence for a delay map a). Timing/timingStep/timing/delays/completionEvent: the deterministic schedule (count, starts, iters, clock) driven by an arrival rule, the induced a_k, and the completion rule of the universal model.
edge_cases: Stops are applied right after each update (equivalently at the start of the next loop), at the time of the update; a worker just reset never has delay >= R since R >= 1.
Ties: earliest picks the lowest worker index; the others arrive later at the same time.
No completion (none reply): the state is unchanged.
